_banned_note: typesafe/jev-router is a DIFFERENT routing product that delegates to other models. ~typesafe/jev-latest is a floating alias that intentionally tracks future Jev versions. Neither may serve TYPESAFE_JEV.
_comment: Single authoritative TYPESAFE_JEV model contract. Application code requests the LOGICAL PROFILE, never a model string. This file is the only place a model slug is chosen.

TYPESAFE_JEV._note: Direct TypeSafe API echoes the pinned model exactly, e.g. jev-1.13.0 with no build suffix. Verified live 2026-09-27: POST /v1/systemone with model jev-1.13.0 returns 200 with typed answers. The direct catalog only lists jev-latest/jev-preview; the pinned build is served but unlisted.
